drawings.description: croquis : les points $x$, $y$, $z$, $t$ ; une courbe marquée $A$ entoure $x$ et $z$, une accolade marquée $C$ réunit $z$ et $y$, $z$ seul est marqué $D$
drawings.kind: points x, y, z, t with a curve A, a brace C, D
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. The points x, y, z, t with their labels; z marked D above it. The curve A comes down from the upper left of z, passes left of z and of x with a small kink, and runs out to the left edge below x; a long stroke from the Phi of the line above joins it at the kink (computed point; this stroke may be part of the text line "Phi = {A, B, C, ...}", which is not drawn). The brace C between z and y, its point towards C. Left out: the three long oblique strokes striking this part of the page and the heavy scribble under x and y (struck). Disagreement in part: the transcription has A surround x and z; on the crop the curve only passes to their left, it does not close round them. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription says the curve A « entoure x et z »; on the crop it only passes to their left (it does not close round them).

drawings.description: croquis : deux ovales l'un au-dessus de l'autre, reliés par une flèche verticale $\varphi$ (surchargée d'un signe biffé). L'ovale du haut, surmonté d'une accolade marquée $I'$, contient trois points : un point isolé en haut à gauche, relié au point $b$ par un trait épais hachuré, et deux points $a \to b$ reliés par une flèche. L'ovale du bas, marqué $J'$ à gauche et souligné d'une accolade marquée $I$, contient deux points reliés par une flèche. À gauche de l'ovale du haut, un gribouillis biffé
drawings.kind: two ovals joined by phi, with points and arrows
drawings.notes: Upper oval under a brace I': an isolated point at the upper left joined to b by a thick hatched stroke, and a -> b. Lower oval, marked J' on the left, over a brace I: two points joined by an arrow. A vertical arrow phi joins them on the right. Omitted as struck: the sign scribbled out at the foot of the phi arrow, and the scribble at the left of the upper oval. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
